senses.sense_definition: A state of peaceful agreement, harmony, or friendly union among people or groups.

examples.text: The two neighboring countries finally managed to live in peaceful <w>concord</w> after decades of conflict.

senses.sense_definition: Agreement between words in grammatical features such as number, gender, case, or person.

Subject-verb <w>concord</w> is a fundamental rule in standard English grammar.

senses.sense_definition: A formal treaty, compact, or covenant established between parties or nations.

examples.text: The international <w>concord</w> was signed by delegates from twenty nations to regulate maritime trade.
Both rulers agreed to honor the terms of the historic <w>concord</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A harmonious combination of musical tones sounded together; consonance.

examples.text: The choir produced a sweet musical <w>concord</w> that filled the entire cathedral.

senses.sense_definition: A sweet American variety of grape having large, dark blue or purple fruit in tight bunches.

senses.sense_definition: An agreement made in a court of law to settle an action for the conveyance of land.

examples.text: The parties finalized a formal <w>concord</w> before the judge to settle the disputed estate.
The terms of the <w>concord</w> ensured that the property was transferred without further litigation.

traits.comment: used in historical English property law
